country_selection: for each country, find its oldest known ocis_updated_at; recommend the country with the oldest date
item_selection: within the selected country, sort by ocis_updated_at ascending and recommend up to 5 items
missing_date_rule: items without ocis_updated_at are shown as date-unknown and excluded from automatic ranking
rules: Do not store or require OCIS body text.
Do not store current values or replacement proposals.
Do not classify UPDATE/KEEP/REVIEW in this dashboard.
Recommendation ranking is based only on OCIS displayed update date.
When the user asks for actual latest-information research after a recommendation, perform that as a separate task and show sources.
